body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Análises.
**Expressões:** far-reaching consequences.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo integrar leitura, escuta, fala e escrita em um editorial analítico e usar far-reaching consequences.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: A Small Change with Far-Reaching Consequences
paras: The decision to move school start times by one hour looks small. Yet analysts **associate** later starts **with** better attendance, and economists **estimate** gains in lifetime earnings. **It is said that** teenagers need more sleep; **it is now known that** tired students learn less.

**The more** we look at the data, **the more** convincing it becomes. We therefore **recommend that** schools **adopt** later starts, **taking** transport costs **into consideration**. Policies with **far-reaching consequences** should be tested first; a pilot is wiser than a promise.

items.q: Analysts link later start times with better attendance.
items.why: associate later starts with better attendance.

items.q: The editors prefer a pilot to a promise.

blocks.body: Um editorial analítico: **afirmação → evidência → raciocínio → recomendação**. Combine estruturas sem torná-lo pesado.

items.s: Analysts ___ later starts with better attendance. (associate)
We recommend that schools ___ later starts. (adopt)
The more we look, the more ___ it becomes. (convincing)
Policies with far-reaching ___ should be tested. (consequences)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **far-reaching consequences** — consequências de grande alcance
**Ripple through society** — Reverberar pela sociedade
**The long and short of it** — Em resumo
**A double-edged sword** — Uma faca de dois gumes
**Open a can of worms** — Abrir uma caixa de Pandora
**Think long term** — Pensar a longo prazo
**Weigh the trade-offs** — Pesar as compensações
**Look before you leap.** — Pense antes de agir.
**What is our main claim?** — Qual é nossa afirmação principal?
**That later school starts have far-reaching consequences.** — Que horários escolares mais tardios têm consequências de grande alcance.
**What do we recommend?** — O que recomendamos?

blocks.title: Editorial meeting
lines: That later school starts have far-reaching consequences.
Que horários escolares mais tardios têm consequências de grande alcance.
That schools run a pilot first.
Que as escolas façam um piloto primeiro.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Ênfase intencional: a palavra mais importante da frase recebe o acento mais forte e a nota mais alta, para marcar contraste ou correção.
words: It was the POLICY, not the person.
We need MORE time, not more money.

prompts.model: Analysts associate later starts with better attendance.

prompts.q: Make a recommendation with the subjunctive.
prompts.model: We recommend that schools adopt later starts.
Small changes can have far-reaching consequences.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence analytical editorial paragraph using at least four structures from earlier units.
blocks.model: A change in opening hours may seem minor. Analysts associate it with higher attendance. It is estimated that earnings rise over a lifetime. The more data we examine, the stronger the case becomes. Taking costs into consideration, we recommend that councils run a pilot. Policies with far-reaching consequences deserve careful testing. A promise is not a plan.

items.why: **school start time** = horário de início da escola.
**lifetime earnings** = ganhos ao longo da vida.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
